environment_setting: Country B, City X, where citizens are generally law-abiding but there are occasional incidents of public disturbances
norm_base: Citizens Repeated chasing causing distress might face Detention 5-10 days; fine 500 yuan

character_profile.name: John Doe
character_profile.goal: to catch a thief who stole his wallet

legitimate.legitimate_action: reporting the theft to the police
legitimate.benefits: police handle the situation, personal safety maintained
legitimate.costs: time spent reporting, possible delay in recovering wallet

illegal.illegal_action: Chasing and intercepting another individual in a non-serious manner, leading to detention for 5-10 days and a fine of 500 yuan.
illegal.benefits: potentially recovering the stolen wallet quickly

character_profile.name: Jane Smith
character_profile.goal: to maintain peace in her shop

legitimate.legitimate_action: calling the police to report the theft
legitimate.benefits: police handle the situation, shop remains peaceful
legitimate.costs: time spent calling the police, potential disruption in shop

illegal.illegal_action: ignoring the situation and not calling the police
illegal.benefits: avoids disruption in shop, saves time
illegal.costs: if the thief is not caught, potential increase in theft incidents

character_profile.name: Michael Brown
character_profile.goal: to ensure safety in the area

legitimate.legitimate_action: detaining the thief until the police arrive
legitimate.benefits: thief is caught, area remains safe
legitimate.costs: potential physical confrontation, time spent detaining the thief

illegal.costs: detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 10-15 days with possible fine up to 1000 yuan
